# Frozen grandfather list for schema_contract_check_test.go (Epic #5978).
#
# Each line is <file>|<function or ->|<normalised statement>: a destructive or
# narrowing schema statement that already existed before the contract check did.
#
# This list may only shrink. Entries may only be removed: the check fails when a line
# matches no statement in the tree, so deleting a statement forces deleting its line.
# Adding a line is a reviewed exception, the same posture as
# scripts/complexity/manifest.json. A new destructive statement is declared as a
# ContractStep (Go) or with a "-- schema:contract unused-since=<n>" comment (SQL)
# instead. A moved or edited statement is a new statement and needs one of those.
schemas.go|dropSingleColumnRegistrationClaimKey|DROP TABLE cfgms_registration_token_claims
schemas.go|CreateStewardRecordsTable|DROP INDEX IF EXISTS uq_steward_records_tenant_device
schemas.go|CreateRateCountersTable|ALTER TABLE cfgms_rate_counters ALTER COLUMN expires_at SET NOT NULL
